title: Bug 1971060 - Make virtual folders work with the new database. r=BenC The main problems here are the virtual folder view going into an infinite loop waiting for message databases to be closed, and virtual folders being removed at start-up because they don't exist in the profile like real folders. I've temporarily disabled the folder listener which updates virtual folders when the real folder hierarchy changes.
